statusDetail: Complete atomic audit of the HTTP 403 regional restriction page delivered to this audit environment. The underlying Yahoo search experience was not reachable from this region; all verdicts apply to the delivered restriction surface, not the Japan-region search application.

page.notes: The target consistently delivered a bilingual EEA/UK unavailability notice with HTTP 403. It is a single static page with no JavaScript, forms, internal routes, manifest, or service worker.

paths.description: The only reachable archetype: the server-rendered EEA/UK availability restriction notice, tested as the landing state, narrow/mobile reflow, preference variants, no-JavaScript crawler view, and error-route behavior. Navigation discovery found only outgoing service/help links; the Japan-region search form/results and separate destination hosts were not covered because the target returns HTTP 403 from this environment.

findings.summary: The page ignores the user’s dark color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark screenshot is pixel-equivalent to the light capture; the dark-mode probe reports html background rgb(255,255,255), color-scheme normal, and no color-scheme CSS signal.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and provide preference-driven dark surface, text, link, border, and logo treatments.

findings.summary: The page has no high-contrast adaptation and some essential links remain below WCAG contrast minimums.
findings.evidence: The platform probe finds no prefers-contrast or forced-colors CSS; axe reports link contrast ratios of 4.04–4.17:1 where 4.5:1 is required.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors and prefers-contrast treatments that preserve visible text, links, focus, and boundaries; avoid overriding system colors where forced colors are active.

findings.summary: Many mobile link targets are substantially shorter than the recommended touch target.
findings.evidence: At 360px, the target-size probe measures several primary links at 16–21px tall and footer links at 14px tall; keyboard focus itself remains visible.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase interactive target boxes to at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels, preferably about 44 by 44 for primary touch actions, using padding without reducing text spacing.

findings.summary: Observed LCP narrowly misses the good threshold in this test.
findings.evidence: The trace summary reports LCP 2549.39ms, about 49ms beyond the 2.5s good threshold; CLS is only 0.001 and TBT is 13.15ms.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce the document and critical-style latency and verify LCP with repeated lab runs plus field data before treating this narrow miss as systemic.

findings.summary: Five parser-inserted external stylesheets delay first rendering.
findings.evidence: The HAR summary identifies five render-blocking stylesheet candidates, all confirmed in the rendered DOM; FCP and LCP occur together at 2549.39ms.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline the small above-the-fold critical CSS, consolidate the remaining styles, and defer non-critical styles while preserving a usable unstyled fallback.

findings.summary: Essential links fail WCAG AA text contrast.
findings.evidence: axe-core reports 21 affected link nodes at 4.04–4.17:1 against white, below the required 4.5:1 for their sizes and weights.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a darker link color that reaches at least 4.5:1 in every state, then rerun automated contrast testing and visually verify focus/visited states.

findings.summary: The heading and landmark hierarchy is malformed.
findings.evidence: The document starts with H3 then H2 elements and has no H1; axe also reports that the contentinfo footer is nested inside main. Focus indication on links is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Use one descriptive H1, nest subsequent headings sequentially, and move the footer/contentinfo landmark outside main.

findings.summary: Mobile pinch zoom is explicitly disabled.
findings.evidence: The viewport is width=device-width,user-scalable=no; axe classifies this as a critical accessibility violation. Narrow reflow itself has no horizontal overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove user-scalable=no and do not cap maximum-scale so users can magnify content.

findings.summary: The logo lacks an intrinsic height and is massively oversized for its rendered slot.
findings.evidence: The image audit reports a 1933px-wide PNG rendered at 170px, with a width attribute but no height attribute.
findings.suggestedFix: Export a correctly sized modern-format logo and provide both intrinsic width and height while preserving its aspect ratio.

findings.summary: The page has a descriptive title but no meta description.
findings.evidence: DOM and discoverability probes find the title in raw HTML but no meta[name=description].
findings.suggestedFix: Add a concise, unique Japanese/English description explaining regional unavailability and the available alternatives.

findings.summary: Some link text is non-descriptive and crawler control endpoints are not available from this region.
findings.evidence: The DOM contains multiple links labelled only “here”; /robots.txt returns the same HTTP 403 restriction document instead of robots text. All anchors do have real href values.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace generic “here” labels with destination-specific text and ensure robots.txt remains intentionally and consistently served for the regional host policy.

findings.summary: The HTTPS response lacks baseline security headers.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive finds no Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security, or X-Content-Type-Options; there are no cookies or mixed-content signals.
findings.suggestedFix: Send a restrictive CSP, HSTS, and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on this static restriction response.

findings.summary: Several browser-enforced defensive policies are absent.
findings.evidence: X-Frame-Options is SAMEORIGIN, but Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are missing and no CSP frame-ancestors policy is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a strict Referrer-Policy, a least-privilege Permissions-Policy, and frame-ancestors in CSP while retaining compatible clickjacking protection.

findings.summary: The bilingual document has no language metadata and no logical-property CSS signal.
findings.evidence: The html element has neither lang nor dir; axe reports html-has-lang, while the platform probe finds no logical inline/block properties.
findings.suggestedFix: Set the primary html lang, identify the alternate-language section with lang, provide appropriate direction metadata, and migrate layout spacing to logical properties.

findings.summary: The only content image wastes pixels and uses a legacy PNG without responsive alternatives.
findings.evidence: The image audit reports a 1933px source displayed at 170px, no srcset, and PNG format; it transfers 13,017 bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve an SVG or right-sized AVIF/WebP/PNG variant with intrinsic dimensions and an appropriate srcset where raster output remains necessary.
